newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian cities' June CPI due on June 20 and 23.
newsitem.headline: Italian cities' June CPI due on June 20 and 23.

text.p: The first five of 11 Italian cities, including Milan, will release their preliminary consumer prices data for June on Friday June 20, national statistics institute Istat said.

Genoa, Trieste, Florence and Bari in addition to Milan will release their inflation data on June 20, while Turin, Venice, Bologna, Perugia, Naples and Palermo will announce their figures on Monday June 23, an Istat statement said.
It noted the cities of Grosseto, Udine and Modena would also release their data on June 23 but these did not contribute to the national index.
All data will be announced after 1730 local time (1530 GMT).
Istat will release the national CPI data for June on Friday July 4 at 0900 local time (0700 GMT).
